snippet.title: Survival Machine 1.0 Launches June 12 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Survival Machine, the latest co-op adventure from Grapes Pickers, is leaving Early Access and launching on Steam on June 12!

Get ready to embark on a journey like no other! Survival Machine is a 4-player, third-person survival game where you and your friends explore vibrant, ever-changing biomes while battling Zombieburg, the flying fortress of a mad scientist — all while riding atop a giant, upgradable Machine that serves as your base, your transport, and your fortress.

Build. Explore. Survive.
